subject: Intro: StellarGo — AWS co-sell enablement & joint plan
messages:
From: Amy Jenkins <amy.jenkins@amazon.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>; Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: StellarGo (SaaS observability) — request for co-sell intro

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Quick intro — I’m Amy, the AWS Partner Manager for the FinOps & Observability practice. StellarGo (cc: Sasha) is an enterprise observability vendor with strong traction in retail and logistics; they’ve raised a Series C and are prioritizing go-to-market expansion with AWS.

StellarGo asked if we could facilitate a joint intro with Redwood to discuss a marketplace listing and a co-sell approach (AWS GTM + Redwood inference serving). They’re specifically interested in:
- listing on AWS Marketplace + negotiated pricing options
- a joint account plan for three anchor accounts they’re targeting (listed in the attached brief)
- verifying compliance posture for potential joint proposals (data locality, audit logs)

Can you folks take a look and suggest owners on your side? If helpful, I can schedule a 30–45 minute kick-off with all parties next week.

Attachment: StellarGo_Requirements.pdf (partner brief)

Thanks — Amy
Amy Jenkins
AWS Partner Manager — Marketplace & Co-sell
amy.jenkins@amazon.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Amy Jenkins <amy.jenkins@amazon.com>; Sasha Goldstein <sasha@stellargo.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: StellarGo (SaaS observability) — request for co-sell intro

Thanks Amy — really appreciate the intro. Sasha, great to e-meet you.

Quick notes from our side:
- I’ll own the executive relationship and customer GTM alignment.
- Laura will drive technical enablement and the marketplace listing process.
- Karthik will support co-sell ops / deal coordination.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30–45m kick-off (AWS + StellarGo + Redwood) to align objectives and anchor accounts.
2) We’ll share a simple joint account plan template ahead of the call so we can populate owners and timelines.
3) If StellarGo has any compliance checklists (SOC2, data residency), please send them; Laura will triage.

Available slots (PDT):
- Wed 9/29 10:00–10:45
- Thu 9/30 14:00–14:45
- Fri 10/1 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, tell us 2–3 preferred times and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached a short intake form we use for co-sell kicks.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
[Attachment: Redwood_CoSell_Intake.pdf]

From: Sasha Goldstein <sasha@stellargo.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Jenkins <amy.jenkins@amazon.com>; procure@stellargo.com
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: StellarGo (SaaS observability) — request for co-sell intro

Hi Vivek — thanks for the quick reply and for mapping owners. We can do Thursday 9/30 at 14:00 PDT — that works for our exec + GTM leads.

A couple items to flag ahead of the call:
- Procurement (procure@stellargo.com) would like a short procurement timeline and any standard SOW/contract gists you commonly use with marketplace listings.
- We have a short compliance packet (data-processing addendum, SOC2 scope) — attaching the high-level summary.

Attaching: StellarGo_Requirements.pdf (same brief), StellarGo_Compliance_Summary.pdf

Agenda suggestion for 30–40m:
1) 5m intros & objectives
2) 10m StellarGo product + target accounts
3) 10m Redwood marketplace & deployment capabilities (private/dedicated/hosted)
4) 5m next steps / owners / timelines

See you Thu 9/30 14:00 PDT.

— Sasha
Sasha Goldstein
Head of Partnerships, StellarGo
sasha@stellargo.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Goldstein <sasha@stellargo.com>; Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Jenkins <amy.jenkins@amazon.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: StellarGo (SaaS observability) — request for co-sell intro

Great — confirmed for Thu 9/30 14:00 PDT. Calendar invite forthcoming.

I put together a short joint account plan (attached) to use as the working doc on the call. Key sections populated:
- Anchor accounts (RetailCo, LogiTrans, BlueMart) with topline use case notes
- Proposed Redwood enablement: marketplace listing, quick-start dedicated pool, and a 30-day pilot plan for BlueMart
- Compliance asks: Laura (me) to run SOC2 scoping with StellarGo + tech checklist for on-prem requirements
- SLAs / commercial: Vivek to own partner commercial questions; Karthik to track deal registration + cosell crediting flow with AWS

Action items (post-call):
- Laura: upload MAP & roadmap to shared Drive (link below) and add owners in the spreadsheet
- Karthik: open a HubSpot deal & link AWS partner record (I’ll share the ID in the notes)
- Sasha: share any internal procurement deadlines and customer contact names for the anchor accounts

Attachments: Stellargo_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, Joint_Roadmap.pdf
Links: https://hubspot.com/deals/HS-98432, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_stellargo-redwood

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Partnerships — Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Amy Jenkins <amy.jenkins@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: StellarGo (SaaS observability) — request for co-sell intro

Thanks all — meeting notes and HubSpot deal have been created (HS-98432). I added the MAP v1 and linked the shared Drive. Pre-reads uploaded here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_stellargo-redwood (same as Laura’s link).

I’ll run registration steps with AWS partner ops after the call; Vivek — want to sync on registration strategy (marketplace listing + discounting cadence) on Friday? 30 minutes works.

-Karthik
